# Observes the capability auditor's excluded-header reads through the
# gofsystrace capRead event emitted beside its file open. Loader reads do
# not contribute, regardless of module index state.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOWORK=off
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd main
env GODEBUG=gofsystrace=1
logos build -o $WORK/bin/bound$GOEXE .
stderr -count=1 'gofsystrace capRead .*dep[/\\]excluded\.go'
stderr '\[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]'
! stderr 'gofsystrace capRead .*main[/\\]excluded\.go'

# A repeat build reads the excluded header exactly once again.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/bound$GOEXE .
stderr -count=1 'gofsystrace capRead .*dep[/\\]excluded\.go'
stderr '\[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]'
! stderr 'gofsystrace capRead .*main[/\\]excluded\.go'

# Workspace mode exempts the build from the capability audit: no excluded
# header read, no warning.
env GOWORK=$WORK/gopath/src/go.work
logos build -o $WORK/bin/bound$GOEXE .
! stderr 'gofsystrace capRead .*dep[/\\]excluded\.go'
! stderr 'gofsystrace capRead .*main[/\\]excluded\.go'
! stderr '\[capabilities::'

-- main/go.mod --
module example.com/bound

go 1.27

require example.com/bounddep v0.0.0
replace example.com/bounddep => ../dep

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/bounddep

go 1.27

-- main/main.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main
import "example.com/bounddep"
func main() { bounddep.F() }

-- dep/dep.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package bounddep
func F() {}

-- dep/excluded.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

//go:build boundexcluded

package bounddep
import _ "unsafe"

-- main/excluded.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

//go:build boundexcluded

package main
import _ "unsafe"

-- main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "warn"

-- go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./main
	./dep
)
